evidence: node scripts/fake-host.mjs has run in the foreground for 10 minutes
its tree uses no CPU and writes nothing
result.diagnosis: A fake host started in the foreground never returns the tool call; releasing the call lets the worker continue.
result.mechanism: node scripts/fake-host.mjs was started in the foreground, so the server runs forever and the bash call never returns
result.avoid: Start the fake host in the background (with &) or under a bounded timeout, then poll it
